closure_unit.outcome: Every record-user grant check (fn::mt109_has_grant, fn::mt109_has_workspace_access, fn::mt109_source_read, fn::mt120_document_access, fn::mt109_ledger_access) and the resource/grant scans of fn::mt120_workspace_delete (W) are served by indexes, so their cost no longer grows with resource_grants / protected_resources rows owned by other workspaces; allow/deny semantics unchanged.

materialized_acceptance.requirement: First step, before any product edit: record in implementation_record.first_step_evidence, from surrealdb-core 3.2.0 source (src/idx/planner/tree.rs:514-520, plan.rs:92-179) plus, if needed, ONE recorded EXPLAIN probe named in a remediation, whether SELECTs inside a DEFINE FUNCTION body evaluated from a PERMISSIONS predicate are planned by the index planner and which WHERE shapes it serves (all-AND, bare LET params, IN-subquery). The rewrite shape in AC-168-2/3 is chosen from this evidence.

The grant SELECTs in fn::mt109_has_grant (schema.surql:6044), fn::mt109_has_workspace_access (:6081), fn::mt109_source_read (:6117), fn::mt120_document_access (:6171) and fn::mt109_ledger_access (:6392) select candidate rows by the exact resource_grants_exact_idx key (account_id, principal_id, access_space_id, resource_id; :5850) with an all-AND WHERE of bare LET params only; expiry, reconciliation_queue, actions/capabilities CONTAINS and delegation_chain filters run as a second step over that candidate set. Flattened sequential early exits (MT164-UDF-AND-CHAIN-STACK-OVERFLOW). Allow/deny results identical for every existing input.

fn::mt120_workspace_delete (schema.surql:6771-7036): the :6782 OR/two-hop protected_resources lookup is replaced by all-AND index-served lookups (a new DEFINE INDEX on protected_resources.parent_resource_id is allowed); the per-owned-resource grant (:6789) and child (:6798) lookups and the per-block/entity (resource_kind, external_resource_id) lookups (:6822, :7015-7016) compare against LET-bound bare params. W allow/deny unchanged, including MT-153 AC-153-8, MT-154 AC-154-6 and MT-157 W rowset behavior.
Existing authority/denial tests stay green (resource_authority_tests, the union core authority selections, MT-153/154/157 workspace-delete tests); stack-overflow count does not rise.

Timing tests in resource_authority_tests.rs (MT-164/MT-166 pattern): for each of the five grant functions and for a workspace delete, the median with 500 unrelated grant/resource rows in other workspaces vs 50 has ratio < 2.0, medians < 250 ms for single grant checks, non-vacuous (asserts the check returned true/false as expected).

Schema pins handled as in MT-164 AC-164-5: one SCHEMA_REVISION bump (schema.rs:18, currently 162), GENERATED_SURREALQL_SHA256 re-derived by the builder; runtime-measured pins (EXPECTED_SCHEMA_INFO_SHA256, schema.rs:3201) marked PIN-MEASURE PENDING and measured by the validator before the confirming round.
